Name: Road Kill (Animal Husbandry x Tractor Mod)
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
[color=#ffffff][b][color=#ffff00]*[/color]If you [color=#00ff00]like[/color] my [color=#00ffff]mods[/color] consider [color=#ff0000]Endorsing[/color]![color=#ffff00]*[/color][/b][/color]

[size=4][color=#b6b6b6]Road[/color] [color=#ff0000]Kill[/color][/size] is a compatibility patch for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url].

It lets the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] Meat Cleaver / Meat Wand work while using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url].

[size=4]Optional Wallet Tools support:[/size]

If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47136]Wallet Tools[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47822]Wallet Tools for Tractor Mod[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47465]Wallet Tools for Animal Husbandry[/url] are all installed, Road Kill also adds the Animal Husbandry tool to the Wallet Tools Tractor selector.

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
